name: dsh-verify
description: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: CLI, MCP, AI-drafted checklists, visual regression, multi-browser. Agents self-test and pass; real browsers tell the truth.

scripts.ci: npm test && node bin/verify.mjs --spec demo/fixed.json --out /tmp/dshv-ci-fixed && ! node bin/verify.mjs --spec demo/buggy.json --out /tmp/dshv-ci-buggy
scripts.smoke: node --test --test-name-pattern 'unknown browser' tests/browsers.test.mjs && node bin/verify.mjs --spec demo/fixed.json --out /tmp/dshv-smoke
